title: Squash CSV Export WIP Into Two Commits
description:
**SITUATION:**

`feature/csv-export` exports Forgeboard sprint boards to CSV so PMs can download card lists. Someone hacked it together late last night — five noisy commits (wip, wip 2 - actually write it, WIP tests, fixup typo in csv_export, wip docs) — and **pushed that diary to `origin`**. The code is fine; the history is not. Your laptop starts on `main`; the noisy tip is only on the remote until you fetch it.

WIP means work in progress: throwaway subjects while exploring. They were never meant for a reviewer.

Priya is reviewing this morning and will not approve a five-commit WIP stack. Rewrite the branch into **exactly two** commits on top of main — one for the export implementation, one for tests + README — with clear subjects (no wip / fixup / typo). Final files must stay the same; only history changes. Then push the rewritten feature so she can review. Do not change `main` yourself.

Your identity (Ada Learner) is already configured. Start on `main` in `~/sprint-service`; `origin` already points at the team forge.

**YOUR TASK:**

1. Fetch from `origin` and check out `feature/csv-export` from the remote tip.
2. Rewrite that branch into exactly two clear commits beyond `main` without changing the final files.
3. Push the rewritten `feature/csv-export` to `origin` (the history changed, so a normal push will be rejected — update the remote tip safely). Do not push or update `main`. Leave a clean working tree.

git rebase -i main — pick/reword/squash/fixup into exactly two commits with clear subjects.
Final tree must match the noisy tip; only history changes.
git push --force-with-lease origin feature/csv-export. Leave main alone.

problemStatement.solution:
# Solution — Squash CSV Export WIP Into Two Commits

Priya will not approve a five-commit WIP stack. That tip is already on `origin`. Rewrite into two clear commits — implementation, then tests + docs — without changing the final tree, then force-with-lease push. Do not push `main`.

## 1. See the noise

```bash
cd ~/sprint-service
git log --oneline main..HEAD
```

## 2. Interactive rebase

```bash
git rebase -i main
```

Keep the first real implementation commit as `pick`, mark the follow-ups as `squash`/`fixup` so you end with **two** commits. Reword subjects so they are clear.

If your editor is awkward:

```bash
git reset --soft main
git restore --staged .
git add src/csv_export.py
git commit -m "Add CSV export for sprint board downloads"
git add tests/test_csv_export.py README.md
git commit -m "Add CSV export tests and README notes"
```

## 3. Verify

```bash
git log --oneline main..HEAD
git status
```

Exactly two commits, clear subjects, clean working tree.

## 4. Publish the rewritten tip

```bash
git push --force-with-lease origin feature/csv-export
```

Do **not** `git push origin main`.
